data.name: Visit 1 Screening Criteria Confirmation
data.description: Visit 2 may only be scheduled once Visit 1 criteria are confirmed
data.text: Visit 2 may occur as soon as the criteria for Visit 1 are confirmed.

data.name: Screening Laboratory Eligibility Review
data.description: Screening laboratory results reviewed at Visit 2 to confirm eligibility
data.text: At Visit 2, screening laboratory results will be reviewed to confirm eligibility.

data.name: Eligibility Confirmation Before Randomization and First Dose
data.description: Inclusion/exclusion criteria confirmed at Visits 1, 2, and 3 prior to randomization and dosing
data.text: Confirm inclusion and exclusion criteria prior to randomization and administration of first dose of study intervention.

data.name: HbA1c Eligibility Range at Screening
data.description: Central laboratory HbA1c range required at Visit 1
data.text: Have HbA1c ≥7.0% (53 mmol/mol) to ≤9.5% (80 mmol/mol), as determined by the central laboratory at Visit 1 (screening).

data.name: Ophthalmologic Eligibility Confirmation
data.description: Eligibility must be confirmed based on fundus photographs and additional ophthalmological evaluation at screening
data.text: Eligibility (see exclusion criterion 13) MUST be confirmed based on fundus photographs and any additional ophthalmological evaluation needed.

data.name: Retinopathy/DME-Based Follow-up Imaging
data.description: Week 24 follow-up fundus photography performed only in participants with retinopathy or DME at baseline
data.text: Perform follow-up fundus photography and any additional ophthalmological evaluation at Week 24 (±4 weeks) only if retinopathy or DME were present at baseline.

data.name: Pregnancy Test Result Required Before First Dose
data.description: Local urine pregnancy test result must be available before first dose for WOCBP
data.text: The result must be available before the first dose of study intervention for WOCBP. Perform additional pregnancy tests if a menstrual period is missed, if there is clinical suspicion of pregnancy, or as required by local law or regulation.

data.name: Non-Fasting Attendance at Fasting Visit
data.description: Visit must be rescheduled if participant attends a fasting visit in non-fasting state
data.text: If a participant attends a fasting visit in the non-fasting state, reschedule the visit at a time within the allowable visit interval.

data.name: Hepatic Laboratory Criteria for Interruption/Discontinuation
data.description: Laboratory thresholds in participants with elevated baseline hepatic values
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5.

data.name: Low BMI / Excessive Weight Reduction
data.description: Dose reduction and weight monitoring for participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction
data.text: Management of participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction, including recommendation for monitoring weight after dose reduction.

data.name: Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.description: Participants with or at risk of poor nutrition or dehydration require monitoring, dose modification, or discontinuation
data.text: Added the option of dose modification for participants with poor nutrition or dehydration; monitoring and managing nutritional and hydration status throughout the study (Section 6.6.2, Appendix 11).

data.name: Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.description: Condition triggering rescue therapy
data.text: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia (Section 6.9.4).

data.name: Pregnancy During Study
data.description: Pregnancy requires discontinuation of study intervention and withdrawal from study
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Gastrointestinal Tolerability
data.description: GI tolerability issues may trigger dose modification or temporary interruption of study intervention
data.text: Dose modification and temporary interruption of study intervention related to and unrelated to gastrointestinal tolerability (Sections 6.6, 6.6.4).

data.name: Exceptional Circumstances Visit Conduct
data.description: Alternative visit conduct guidance for pandemics or natural disasters
data.text: For those participants whose participation in this study is affected by exceptional circumstances, such as pandemics or natural disasters, refer to Section 10.14 for additional guidance.

data.name: Early Discontinuation Timing for DID-EQ
data.description: DID-EQ administered at ED visit only if discontinuation occurs at or before Week 4
data.text: At ED if discontinuation is at or before Week 4.

data.name: Screening to Treatment Period Transition
data.text: Visit 3 (randomization) to occur no sooner than 18 days after Visit 1 and within the up-to-4-week screening period; inclusion and exclusion criteria must be confirmed and screening labs/fundus eligibility reviewed prior to randomization via IWRS and administration of the first dose.

data.name: Randomized Assignment to Treatment Arms
data.text: Approximately 480 participants will be randomly assigned in a 1:1:1:1 ratio to retatrutide 4 mg, retatrutide 9 mg, retatrutide 12 mg, or placebo via IWRS at Visit 3.

data.name: Treatment Period to Safety Follow-up Transition
data.text: A posttreatment safety follow-up visit (Visit 801) will occur approximately 4 weeks following the last treatment period visit (Visit 11, Week 40).

data.name: Hepatic Criteria for Study Intervention Interruption or Discontinuation
data.text: ALT or AST ≥2x baseline or ≥250 U/L (whichever occurs first) and TBL ≥2x ULN or INR ≥1.5 requires study drug interruption/discontinuation with close hepatic monitoring (Sections 7.1.2, 8.2.6.3).

data.name: Discontinuation for Poor Nutrition or Dehydration
data.text: New discontinuation criterion added in Section 7.1 to facilitate the management of participants with poor nutrition or dehydration.

data.name: Discontinuation and Withdrawal for Pregnancy
data.text: Any female participant who becomes pregnant while participating in the study will discontinue study intervention and will be withdrawn from the study.

data.name: Temporary Interruption of Study Intervention
data.text: Temporary interruption of study intervention may occur related to gastrointestinal tolerability or for reasons unrelated to gastrointestinal tolerability (Sections 7.1.3, 6.6.4).

data.name: Blinded Dose Modification via IWRS
data.text: All dose adjustments are managed through IWRS in a blinded fashion, including dose modification for gastrointestinal tolerability, poor nutrition or dehydration, and BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction.

data.name: Dose Reduction for BMI ≤20 kg/m2
data.text: For participants with BMI ≤20 kg/m2 or perceived excessive weight reduction, dose reduction with subsequent monitoring of weight after dose reduction is recommended (Section 6.6.3).

data.name: Rescue Therapy for Severe Persistent Hyperglycemia
data.text: Rescue therapy for severe persistent hyperglycemia may be initiated per Section 6.9.4; initiation of additional antihyperglycemic medication is an intercurrent event for the efficacy estimand.

data.name: Early Discontinuation Visit Transition
data.text: For early discontinuation that occurs before the last visit in the treatment period, perform the activities listed for ED in the SoA.

data.name: Waiver of Safety Follow-up Visit
data.text: Participants who have discontinued study intervention early and are only willing to come back for Visit 11 (Week 40) are not required to complete a safety follow-up visit if they have been off of study intervention for at least 28 days (Section 7.1.1).

data.name: Early Discontinuation of Study Intervention
data.description: Permanent discontinuation from study intervention per Section 7.1.1, including hepatic criteria, pregnancy, and poor nutrition/dehydration; ED visit assessments performed if discontinuation occurs before the last treatment period visit.

data.name: Participant Discontinuation/Withdrawal from Study
data.description: Participant discontinuation/withdrawal from the study per Section 7.2, including withdrawal of consent and withdrawal following pregnancy.

data.name: Lost to Follow-up
data.description: Participant unable to be contacted and considered lost to follow-up per Section 7.3.

data.name: Study Completion
data.description: Completion of the 40-week treatment period (Visit 11, Week 40) and the 4-week safety follow-up period (Visit 801), including eDiary return.

data.name: Completion Without Safety Follow-up Visit
data.description: Participants who discontinued study intervention early, attend only Visit 11 (Week 40), and have been off study intervention for at least 28 days complete the study without a safety follow-up visit.

data.name: Screening Eligibility Decision
data.description: At Visit 2, screening laboratory results and fundus photography are reviewed to confirm eligibility before scheduling randomization.

data.name: Randomization Decision
data.description: At Visit 3 (Week 0), inclusion/exclusion criteria are confirmed and WOCBP pregnancy test result must be available before randomization via IWRS and first dose.

data.name: Hepatic Safety Decision
data.description: Decision point for study intervention interruption or discontinuation and close hepatic monitoring frequency (every 1 to 2 weeks if stabilized).

data.name: Dose Modification Decision for Tolerability/Nutrition/Low BMI
data.description: Blinded dose modification, temporary interruption, or discontinuation decisions managed through IWRS at treatment period visits.

data.name: Week 24 Ophthalmologic Follow-up Decision
data.description: Follow-up fundus photography at Week 24 (±4 weeks) performed only if retinopathy or DME present at baseline.

data.name: Rescue Therapy Decision
data.description: Decision to initiate rescue therapy for severe persistent hyperglycemia during the treatment period.

data.name: Safety Follow-up Visit Requirement Decision
data.description: Determination of whether Visit 801 is required based on time off study intervention (≥28 days) and participant willingness.
